description: Notification bell button with an unread badge and a dropdown of notifications (with an unread filter and mark-all-read); clicking an item marks it read and navigates. Polls the notification service on an interval.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class on the notification center root.

parameters.name: CurrentUserId
parameters.description: Additional CSS class on the notification center root.

parameters.name: OnDropdownOpenChanged
parameters.description: User whose notifications should be shown in the center.

parameters.name: PollInterval
parameters.description: Raised whenever the dropdown is opened or closed.
